merchant_not_found_description: The link may be mistyped or incomplete.
merchant_route_error_description: We couldn't show this screen. Start the charge again.
merchant_invalid_charge_description: The link is missing the amount or has been changed. Create the charge again.
merchant_charge_form_description: Enter the amount to generate the payment QR code.
merchant_charge_form_concept_hint: Optional. The student sees it when paying.
merchant_amount_invalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 1.20.
merchant_amount_not_positive: The amount must be greater than 0.
merchant_charge_qr_listen_error: We stopped listening for the payment. If the student has already paid, it will show up when you retry.
merchant_metrics_empty: Here you'll see how the payments you collect on this device are detected.
merchant_metrics_median_hint: How long checking the payment takes once detected: median
merchant_metrics_p95_hint: 95% of payments are checked in this time or less
merchant_metrics_via_notification_hint: The RPC reported the payment through the subscription: the fast path
merchant_metrics_via_look_back_hint: The notification didn't arrive or arrived late: the every-second check found it
merchant_metrics_footnote: Times are how long a payment takes to be checked once detected. The last 50 charges are kept.
wallet_not_found_description: The link may be mistyped or may no longer exist.
wallet_load_error_description: Check your internet connection and try again.
wallet_route_error_description: We couldn't show this screen. Try again.
wallet_login_description: Pay on campus with your university email. We create your wallet the first time you sign in.
wallet_sol_balance_empty: You need SOL to pay the network fee.
wallet_sol_balance_low: You're running low on SOL for network fees.
wallet_pay_description: Scan the merchant's QR code or paste its link.
wallet_link_invalid: This link isn't a valid charge.
wallet_link_no_reference: This charge has no reference: the merchant couldn't confirm it.
wallet_link_memo: This charge includes a memo, which Uallet doesn't support.
wallet_scan_description: Point at the code the merchant shows.
wallet_scan_multiple_codes: There are several payment codes in view. Point at just one.
wallet_scan_error_insecure_context: The camera only works over a secure connection (HTTPS). Paste the link.
wallet_scan_error_permission_denied: Allow camera access in your browser or paste the link.
wallet_scan_error_no_camera: We couldn't find a camera. Paste the link.
wallet_scan_error_failed: Couldn't start the QR reader. Paste the link.
wallet_confirm_name_unverified: The merchant writes this name: it isn't verified.
wallet_confirm_already_paid: This charge is already paid. If you didn't pay it, ask the merchant for a new charge.
wallet_payment_in_progress: Wait for the payment to finish.
wallet_payment_failure_no_funds: You don't have enough balance for this payment.
wallet_payment_failure_no_sol: You don't have enough SOL for the network fee.
wallet_payment_failure_failed: The payment didn't go through. Try again.
wallet_payment_failure_unknown: We don't know whether the payment went through. Check your balance before trying again.
wallet_metrics_empty: Here you'll see how long the payments you make from this device take.
wallet_metrics_p95_hint: 95% of payments take this long or less
wallet_metrics_stage_prepare_hint: Build the transaction, fetch the blockhash and simulate it
wallet_metrics_stage_confirm_hint: Send it and wait for the network to confirm it
wallet_metrics_footnote: Measured on this device, from when you tap “Pay”. The last 50 payments are kept.
